title: Snorkel San Diego's Mission Bay with a Marine Biologist
includes: Wetsuits are NOT provided and must be rented separately (~$17 for a rental)
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Not recommended for children under 10 years old
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Family-friendly experience where you can both see and learn about life in our bays and oceans from a marine biologist with over 20 years of combined science, education, and museum experience. 

Explore San Diego's hidden gem of snorkeling! Everyone who visits San Diego knows about La Jolla, but did you know there's an even better snorkeling spot? Avoid the big waves and crowds with this more relaxed snorkel experience geared for all skill levels.

Groups are small (maximum of 5 participants, with exceptions for private groups/families) which makes a more intimate and personal experience. 

**Important: After booking you will receive a welcome message with important details. Be sure to have notifications and/or emails from your booking platform turned on!**
